# Three World Empire
The [bold]Three World Empire[/bold] (TWE or 3WE) is a superpower formed in 2088 when the United Kingdom and Japan pooled their lead in space exploration and joined with India and other developing nations. It takes its name from the first three worlds humanity settled: [bold]Earth, Mars and Titan[/bold]. As the first power to colonize beyond Sol, it holds more colonies than anyone else, and is the most technologically advanced nation.
## Government - A parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy. The British and Japanese royal families, joined by marriage, are figureheads; real power lies with an elected parliament led by a Prime Minister. - Distant worlds are run by a provisional governor. - [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"], born from the TWE, holds a permanent seat in parliament, the only company to do so. - Its territory, the [bold]Anglo-Japanese Arm[/bold], covers most colonies in the Core Systems and the Outer Veil. Further out, colonization is mostly left to Weyland-Yutani.
## Recent Troubles - In 2148 its corporate colonies broke away to become the [textlink="Independent Core System Colonies" link="CMUGuideLoreICSC"]. - From 2172, food shortages sparked the [bold]Australia Wars[/bold], an uprising in Australia and on Australian-founded worlds. The wars ended in 2182 with a nuclear strike on Australia's Capital. - Many far-out TWE colonies have defected to the [textlink="Union of Progressive Peoples" link="CMUGuideLoreUPP"].
## Relations - [bold]United Americas[/bold]: mostly peaceful allies, but the UA watches the TWE's expansion closely, and the TWE fears being dragged into the UA's quarrels with Weyland-Yutani. - [bold]Union of Progressive Peoples[/bold]: hostile; a cold war fought over the Outer Rim. - [bold]ICSC[/bold]: reluctantly allied, the TWE's navy helps defend ICSC space.
## Civil Organizations - [bold]Neroid Sector Policing Authority[/bold] (NSPA): the NSPA is the 3WE's main Law Enforcement branch in the Neroid Sector.
## Forces - [bold]Imperial Armed Space Forces[/bold] (IASF): the TWE's navy and main fighting force. - [bold]Royal Marine Commandos[/bold] (RMC): the TWE's elite. Highly disciplined and well equipped, trained in rapid deployment, boarding actions, reconnaissance, sabotage and precision strikes far behind enemy lines. - [bold]Special Air Service[/bold] (SAS): the TWE's tier one special forces.
